name: photohistory
description: Liquid Glass photo archive — Next.js + Rust (WASM)

scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build wasm --target web --release && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('public/wasm')){console.log('public/wasm missing — run: npm run wasm')};process.exit(0)"
